games.name: Westhaven 🏡 RP [ALPHA]
games.description:
Move to the city. Get a job. Get a car. Get a house.

Drive a bus, sling garbage, run a taxi, haul packages, or ride the ambulance.

Then everything else:
🚗 Buy cars, park them in your own garage
🏠 Buy a house and actually furnish it
📱 A phone that works. Texts, music, camera, browser, games, stock market
🎸 Pick up a guitar or sit at the piano and play real notes
🌊 Food places, arcades, a whole city to mess around in

This is an ALPHA. Stuff is missing. Plenty of features to come in the future.

Join the group. Leave a like if you're having fun.

games.name: Steal a Ghost
games.description:
Steal the rarest ghosts on Spooky Lane! Catch cute ghosts with your Ghost Vacuum, carry them home to your haunted manor and earn Ecto every second, then sneak into other manors and steal theirs.

- Steal ghosts from other players' manors and zap thieves to defend yours
- 26 ghosts from Common to Secret, with Golden, Shadow, Frost, Blood Moon, Rainbow and Cosmic mutations
- Six spooky zones: Graveyard, Pumpkin Patch, Whispering Woods, Witch Swamp, Crypt Ruins and the Phantom Castle
- Outrun the Wardens and put up your Barrier before thieves arrive
- Server events: Blood Moon, Frost Night, Golden Hour, Ecto Rush, Spirit Storm and Cosmic Rift
- Upgrade your vacuum, speed and backpack, complete the Ghostpedia and Rebirth for huge boosts

Play with friends for bonus Ecto! Codes: GHOSTS, SPOOKY, RELEASE

games.name: Wreck Range: Launch Cars & Crash
games.description:
Launch cars into a giant crash range, smash them to pieces and cash out. Aim, nail the PERFECT power shot, steer and boost in the air, then watch your car crumple, lose doors and wheels and explode into the targets.

- Real-time crash physics: dents, flying parts, glass and fuel tank jackpots
- Land in x2, x3, x5 and x10 rings, bowl a STRIKE, hit the golden Jackpot Bus
- Unlock 20 cars, from a City Hatchback to the Hot Tub Monster
- Upgrade your launcher from a slingshot ramp to the Sky Dropper
- Rebirth for permanent multipliers and new cars
- Take down the MEGA WRECK with the whole server
- Daily rewards, quests, playtime gifts and the Wreck Pass

PC, phone, tablet and console. Favorite to catch new cars and ranges.

Update log: v0.1 - the range opens with 20 cars, 6 launchers and the MEGA WRECK event.

games.name: FLYBALL
games.description:
🧹 Two teams of four. One sky. Five minutes on the clock.

🏐 Chasers carry the Volley and throw it through the other team's hoops for 10 points. 🧤 The Keeper guards the hoops. ✨ The Seeker hunts the Wisp, a tiny runaway worth 30 points that escapes again soon after it's caught. 💥 and Busters roam the arena looking for someone to knock off a broom. Bat one at a rival, or skip the middleman and swing at them yourself.

📣 Call for a pass and your teammates will look for you, bots included. Queue against real players, bring up to three friends in a party 👥, or warm up against bots on Rookie, Pro or Legend. 🤖

⭐ Every match earns XP.
